body_markdown:
When you withdraw from Payoneer in Nigeria, the platform converts your dollars to naira before the money reaches your local bank. You cannot choose to keep the dollars, and you cannot pick the best moment to convert. If you earn in dollars, that one rule can quietly eat into your income.


There is a better way. You can send your Payoneer balance to your Cleva USD account, keep it in dollars for as long as you like, and convert to naira only when it suits you. In this guide, you will learn why the default process costs you, how to move money from Payoneer to Cleva, and why converting on Cleva is cheaper.


### **Why forced naira conversion is a problem**


Many Nigerian freelancers, remote workers, and businesses use Payoneer to receive payments from international clients and marketplaces. It works well for receiving money. The challenge starts when you try to withdraw.


Payoneer pays out to Nigerian bank accounts in naira. That means:


- **You lose control of timing.** The exchange rate on the day you withdraw is the rate you get, whether it is good or bad.
- **You lose your dollars.** Once the platform converts the money, you cannot get it back as dollars without paying again to convert.
- **You pay more.** Payoneer’s conversion rate often costs more than the rate you can get elsewhere like Cleva.


If you earn in dollars to protect yourself from naira volatility, forced conversion defeats the purpose.


### **A smarter way to withdraw from Payoneer in Nigeria**


Instead of withdrawing to a Nigerian bank account, you can withdraw from Payoneer to your Cleva USD account. Cleva gives you US account details, so Payoneer treats it like a regular US bank account. Your money arrives as dollars, with no forced conversion.


Once the money lands in Cleva, you decide what happens next. You can:


- Hold it in dollars.
- Convert all or part of it to naira.
- Spend it with your Cleva Classic Card.
- Send it to someone else.


This flexibility is the biggest reason people choose to withdraw from Payoneer in Nigeria through Cleva.


### **How to withdraw from Payoneer to Cleva**


Follow these steps to link your accounts and move your money:


1. **Open your Cleva account.**[Download the Cleva app](https://www.getcleva.com/api/download) and complete your verification.
2. **Get your USD account details.** Find your US account number and routing details in the app.
3. **Log in to Payoneer.** Go to the withdrawal section and choose to add a US bank account.
4. **Enter your Cleva details.** Make sure the name on your Cleva account matches the name on your Payoneer account.
5. **Start your withdrawal.** Select the amount and confirm. Your dollars arrive in Cleva once the transfer is processed.


Always double-check your account details before you confirm. A small typo can delay your transfer.


### **Why converting to naira Is cheaper on Cleva**


Some people need naira right away, and that is fine. Even then, it makes sense to route your money through Cleva first. When you convert your dollars to naira on Cleva, the cost is lower than converting on Payoneer.


You also get to choose your moment. If the rate looks good today, convert. If you want to wait, keep your dollars. Payoneer does not give you that choice.


### **How to receive Amazon KDP payments in Nigeria**


If you publish on Amazon KDP, this section matters to you. Amazon KDP payments cannot go directly into a Cleva account at the moment. You can still get your royalties into Cleva by routing them through Payoneer.


Here is how it works:


1. Set up your Payoneer account to receive your KDP royalties.
2. Wait for Amazon to pay into Payoneer.
3. Withdraw from Payoneer to your Cleva USD account using the steps above.


This route lets you collect your royalties in dollars and avoid Payoneer’s forced naira conversion.


### **Why businesses should withdraw from Payoneer to Cleva**


Businesses that receive payments through Payoneer face the same conversion problem, often with much larger amounts. A small difference in exchange rate becomes a big difference in revenue when you receive thousands of dollars a month.


If you run a business, you can move your balance to Cleva and:


- Keep your operating funds in dollars.
- Pay international vendors and subscriptions from your dollar balance.
- Convert to naira only for local expenses like salaries and rent.


This approach gives you more control over your cash flow and protects your margins.


### **Earn Points and save more with Cleva**


Moving money from Payoneer to Cleva does more than save you from forced conversion. Your deposits can also earn you points, so every withdrawal works a little harder for you. You can also move part of your dollars into a Cleva Pot to set money aside for a goal, such as rent, a laptop, or an emergency fund.


When you withdraw the usual way, your money turns into naira and disappears into your account. When you do it through Cleva, you get rewards and tools for saving.
